01001.gametext: Where present under "nighttime conditions," each of your Rebels and aliens at same planet site are power +2, and also have immunity to attrition < 3 if a Hydroponics Station is present.
01001.lore: Simple maintenance and diagnostics droid. Activates alarm sensors, security lighting and power fences on remote installations. KPR servant droids built by Lerrimore Droids.
01001.name: 2X-3KPR (Tooex)
01001.label: 2X-3KPR (Tooex)

01005.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01005.gametext: Subtract 1 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws here.   If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01005.light_side_text: Subtract 1 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws here.
01005.name: Alderaan
01005.label: Alderaan

01006.gametext: Cancel one Effect (or Utinni Effect) by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Sense card just played.
01006.lore: A user of the Force can alter the environment to affect the minds of others. "The Force can have a strong influence on the weak-minded."
01006.name: Alter
01006.label: Alter

01007.gametext: Use 3 Force to deploy on any exterior Tatooine site (free at Beggar's Canyon). You may use any amount of Force in the opponent's Force Pile during your turns. However, if you use more than 1 of the opponent's Force in a turn, Beggar is lost.
01007.lore: Many Mos Eisley citizens, once swindled and robbed, become destitute. Unable to afford off-planet passage, they live in the streets and do odd jobs or beg.
01007.name: Beggar
01007.label: Beggar

01010.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
01010.lore: Piloted Red 3 at Battle of Yavin. Childhood friend of Luke. Led mutiny on Rand Ecliptic and theft of Ecliptic from shipyards on Bestine. Ecliptic Evaders emblem on helmet.
01010.name: Biggs Darklighter
01010.label: Biggs Darklighter

01013.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. Immune to attrition < 3.
01013.lore: Rogue pilot. Outlaw starship tech. Has secret lab in Mos Eisley. He bragged about beating Han Solo's Kessel Run record. Left fringe life behind after meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi.
01013.name: BoShek
01013.label: BoShek

01014.gametext: Total power at same site is +2 for each of your droid/Rebel pairs present, including C-3PO. R2-D2 is forfeit +2 when present.
01014.lore: Cybot Galactica 3PO human-cyborg relations droid. Fluent in over six million forms of communication. 112 years old. Has never been memory-wiped...as far as he knows.
01014.name: C-3PO (See-Threepio)
01014.label: C-3PO (See-Threepio)

01020.gametext: May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
01020.lore: Multi-purpose Rebel Blockade Runner. Modular interior designed for troop or cargo transport. 150 meters long. Used by Rebels, pirates, corporations and the Empire.
01020.name: Corellian Corvette
01020.label: Corellian Corvette

01029.gametext: If both players have a character with a weapon present at same site, deploy on that opponent's character during any control phase. Character loses all weapons, is power -1 and may no longer carry weapons. (Immune to Alter.)
01029.lore: When Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba confronted Luke in the Cantina, Obi-Wan pointed out, "This little one isn't worth the effort." A brawl ensued.
01029.name: Disarmed
01029.label: Disarmed

01030.gametext: If Luke and Han are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector, choose one TIE/ln present to be lost.
01030.lore: Luke and Han made an effective team when defending the Millennium Falcon with its quad laser cannons against attacking TIE fighters. "Great kid! Don't get cocky."
01030.name: Don't Get Cocky
01030.label: Don't Get Cocky

01038.gametext: Once each turn during your control phase, you may use 1 Force to make a 'wager.' Draw three destiny. Opponent draws two destiny. Player with highest total may randomly select one card to be retrieved from that player's Lost Pile.
01038.lore: A male Bith. Musician who leads the Mos Eisley Cantina band, Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes. Expert gambler and card shark.
01038.name: Figrin D'an
01038.label: Figrin D'an

01043.gametext: If Luke and Obi-Wan or Yoda are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Use 1 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take any one lightsaber into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.
01043.lore: Luke relied on Obi-Wan's knowledge and advice to learn the ways of the Force. Obi-Wan continued to counsel Luke long after the old Jedi's apparent 'death.'
01043.name: Gift Of The Mentor
01043.label: Gift Of The Mentor

01046.gametext: Once during battle, may use 1 Force to cancel and re-draw your just drawn destiny. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
01046.lore: Smuggler, gambler and "freelance law-bender." Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns Millennium Falcon. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him "life-debt." Has bounty on head.
01046.name: Han Solo
01046.label: Han Solo

01052.gametext: If one of your droids is at the Dune Sea or where there is a Scomp link, use 1 Force to discard your entire hand to your Used Pile. Draw the same number of cards from your Reserve Deck. Draw one extra card if droid is C-3PO or R2-D2.
01052.lore: Stranded in the Dune Sea, R2-D2 insisted on heading into rocky canyons where he thought settlements were likely to exist. Threepio had other ideas.
01052.name: How Did We Get Into This Mess?
01052.label: How Did We Get Into This Mess?

01054.gametext: Cancel a battle just initiated at any system or sector by moving all your starships and vehicles there away.
01054.lore: "We'll be safe enough once we make the jump to hyperspace." A starship in hyperspace cannot be tracked unless a homing beacon has been hidden aboard.
01054.name: Hyper Escape
01054.label: Hyper Escape

01057.gametext: If you must lose Force for any reason, reduce the loss by X amount by using X Force.
01057.lore: After escaping Detention Block AA-23. Rebels found themselves in the trash compactor. Leia pointed out, "It could be worse." It soon was.
01057.name: It Could Be Worse
01057.label: It Could Be Worse

01061.gametext: If one of your Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Rebels there to battle at double power.
01061.lore: Jedi Knights inspired allies on the battlefield through bravery and heroism. Obi-Wan's presence encouraged the Rebels and gave them a chance to escape the Death Star.
01061.name: Jedi Presence
01061.label: Jedi Presence

01062.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 6, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
01062.lore: Piloted Red 6 at Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing runs. Served in Tierfon Yellow Aces squadron at Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Free trader from Bestine system.
01062.name: Jek Porkins
01062.label: Jek Porkins

01065.gametext: When in a battle, if both players draw only one battle destiny and yours is higher, reduces opponent's destiny to zero. Landspeed = 3. Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. May not be aboard starfighters or enclosed vehicles.
01065.lore: A female Quor'sav, a warm-blooded, avian/monotreme species. 3.5 meters tall. Over-protective mother. Freelance pilot. Has custom-built ship with tall corridors. Lays eggs.
01065.name: Kal'Falnl C'ndros
01065.label: Kal'Falnl C'ndros

01066.dark_side_text: If you control, Kessel Run is prevented (canceled).
01066.gametext: If you control, Force drain +1 here.   If you control, Kessel Run is prevented (canceled).
01066.light_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01066.name: Kessel
01066.label: Kessel

01071.gametext: Adds 1 to power of each Rebel present with her at a Death Star site. 'Diplomatic' immunity to attrition < 2.
01071.lore: Strong-willed princess from Alderaan. Youngest Imperial Senator ever. Used diplomatic immunity to spy for Rebels. Led relief effort on Ralltiir. Natural leader.
01071.name: Leia Organa
01071.label: Leia Organa

01075.gametext: Deploy on your character with ability > 2 and a lightsaber. That character is power +3 in battles or may add 1 to Force drain where present. Effect is lost if character loses lightsaber.
01075.lore: A Jedi learns not only to wield a lightsaber, but how to channel the Force to increase skill and control the lightsaber's damage.
01075.name: Lightsaber Proficiency
01075.label: Lightsaber Proficiency

01076.gametext: While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.
01076.lore: Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
01076.name: Luke Skywalker
01076.label: Luke Skywalker

01079.gametext: Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of table (free if C-3PO on table). After losing any battle: characters, starships and vehicles may be forfeited directly from your hand (for forfeit value) to reduce attrition or battle damage.
01079.lore: Dejarik game uses holograms of mythological and real creatures from across the galaxy. The hulking Mantellian savrip is a nasty predator from Ord Mantell.
01079.name: Mantellian Savrip
01079.label: Mantellian Savrip

01080.gametext: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to attrition < 5 if Han, Chewie or Lando piloting. Has ship-docking capability.
01080.lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. "She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts."
01080.name: Millennium Falcon
01080.label: Millennium Falcon

01081.gametext: During your control phase, may snare (steal) one Bantha, Dewback, Wampa, Rancor, Bubo, or Dragonsnake present at same site.
01081.lore: Male Ithorian, from a tree-loving race derogatorily nicknamed, 'Hammerheads.' Master of animal husbandry and horticulture. Former herd ship leader. Rebel spy.
01081.name: Momaw Nadon
01081.label: Momaw Nadon

01083.gametext: At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
01083.lore: Four-armed smuggler and pilot for hire. A Morseerian male. Breathes methane. Former fighter pilot. He can take you anywhere for the right price.
01083.name: Nabrun Leids
01083.label: Nabrun Leids

01085.gametext: Deploy on any planet system to cause "nighttime conditions" at related sites. During battles there, both sides add one destiny to power only. Spies deploy free to sites under "nighttime conditions."
01085.lore: Tatoo I and Tatoo II, twin suns of Tatooine, create a harsh desert environment, but provide spectacular sunsets. At night, many dangers emerge from the shadows.
01085.name: Nightfall
01085.label: Nightfall

01087.gametext: When a battle was just initiated where present, may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1 present to move away (for free), or that character is lost. Immune to attrition < 5.
01087.lore: Jedi Knight. Trained by Yoda. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.
01087.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
01087.label: Obi-Wan Kenobi

01089.gametext: Deploy on Obi-Wan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
01089.lore: "An elegant weapon for a more civilized time." Miniaturized power cell. Uses rare crystals to focus the lightblade. This lightsaber was personally built by Obi-Wan.
01089.name: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
01089.label: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber

01093.gametext: If opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector where you have a starship with maneuver > 3, use 1 Force to add one battle destiny.
01093.lore: Black market sensor-stealth arrays can be used to hide starships from enemy sensor scans. Stellar interference can naturally shield a starship for surprise attacks.
01093.name: Out Of Nowhere
01093.label: Out Of Nowhere

01100.gametext: While aboard any starfighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver and hyperspeed.
01100.lore: Typical starfighter pilot assistant. Contains ten coordinates for hyperspace jumps. Built-in tools and computer interfaces. R2-X2 was assigned to Red 10 at Yavin Base.
01100.name: R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)
01100.label: R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)

01101.gametext: While aboard a non-creature vehicle, adds 1 to power, maneuver and landspeed. May drive transport vehicles.
01101.lore: One of numerous vehicle computer operation droids, manufactured by Industrial Automation. This unit, R4-E1, is a companion of BoShek. Rambunctious. Fiercely independent.
01101.name: R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)
01101.label: R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)

01103.gametext: Use 1 Force to prevent any character or starship just deployed by the opponent from battling or moving for the remainder of this turn.
01103.lore: While being chased through the Death Star, Luke and Leia disabled the blast doors behind them in order to slow down pursuing stormtroopers.
01103.name: Rebel Barrier
01103.label: Rebel Barrier

01112.gametext: Deploy on any droid at any site. Droid cannot move and cannot utilize its "game text." During your deploy phase, Restraining Bolt may be transferred (for free) to another droid at same site.
01112.lore: Fits in a special socket on a droid's body. When installed, restricts actions of droids, forcing them to follow orders. Can be operated remotely by a 'caller.'
01112.name: Restraining Bolt
01112.label: Restraining Bolt

01115.gametext: Use 3 Force to deploy on any location. Rotate the location so that icons and game texts switch direction. (If Expand the Empire present, it also switches.) If Revolution later canceled, location rotates back again.
01115.lore: Spies and informants gave Rebels vital data to plan strategic turnabouts, create local insurgencies, and hamper Imperial activities.
01115.name: Revolution
01115.label: Revolution

01120.gametext: Cancel one Interrupt (or one 'react') by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Alter card just played.
01120.lore: Users of the Force can sense impending danger by feeling the way the Force flows in others. Cataclysmic events can be sensed (as when Obi-Wan felt Alderaan's destruction).
01120.name: Sense
01120.label: Sense

01122.gametext: If Luke and Leia are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Cancel Imperial Barrier or Wrong Turn or Retract The Bridge.
01122.lore: Luke and Leia escaped to an unused portion of the Death Star, evading security checkpoints. At a retracted bridge, they swung across on a grappling line through enemy fire.
01122.name: Skywalkers
01122.label: Skywalkers

01123.gametext: If Han is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny. OR If any alien is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny.
01123.lore: As a smuggler, Solo must always be alert for trouble, even when appearing relaxed. Bounty hunters are eager to claim the price on the Corellian pirate's head.
01123.name: Solo Han
01123.label: Solo Han

01132.dark_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01132.gametext: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.   If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01132.light_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01132.name: Tatooine
01132.label: Tatooine

01134.dark_side_text: Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each forfeit +1.
01134.gametext: Your aliens here are each power +1.   Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each forfeit +1.
01134.light_side_text: Your aliens here are each power +1.
01134.name: Tatooine: Cantina
01134.label: Tatooine: Cantina

01138.dark_side_text: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
01138.gametext: Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here.   Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
01138.light_side_text: Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here.
01138.name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
01138.label: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm

01139.gametext: During your control phase, you may move free from here directly to Cantina (or vice versa).
01139.light_side_text: During your control phase, you may move free from here directly to Cantina (or vice versa).
01139.name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
01139.label: Tatooine: Mos Eisley

01140.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01140.gametext: Obi-Wan is deploy -3 here.   If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01140.name: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut
01140.label: Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut

01143.gametext: If Luke and an Imperial with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Imperial is Vader).
01143.lore: Luke's piloting skills and Force abilities made his X-wing a difficult target for Darth Vader as they raced down the Death Star trench.
01143.name: The Force Is Strong With This One
01143.label: The Force Is Strong With This One

01146.gametext: Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of table. During your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.
01146.lore: Expert traffic controllers coordinate launches faster than automated launch systems. Rebel bases scramble fighters quickly during Imperial attacks.
01146.name: Traffic Control
01146.label: Traffic Control

01150.gametext: Adds immunity to attrition < 2 to all your vehicles and droids at same location. Also, if 'bantha' droid is at a docking bay, adds immunity to attrition < 3 to all your starfighters at the related system and related sectors and may cancel Lateral Damage.
01150.lore: Unique treadwell droid cobbled together by Jawas. Now owned by the DeMaals, proprietors of Docking Bay 94. Nicknamed 'bantha' for its slow and stubborn personality.
01150.name: WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid
01150.label: WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid

01152.gametext: If you have less than 15 Life Force, play during opponent's control phase. For remainder of turn, each time you must lose Force, the loss is cut in half (round up). If R2-D2 or C-3PO on table, round down.
01152.lore: Threepio's many misadventures often threatened his continued operation. The luckless protocol droid developed a healthy sense of cynicism, and a keen grasp of the obvious.
01152.name: We're Doomed
01152.label: We're Doomed

01153.gametext: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to target an opponent's unoccupied transport vehicle or droid present. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's destiny number, use Force equal to target's deploy cost to 'purchase' target (use as if stolen).
01153.lore: Bought Luke's landspeeder for Spaceport Speeders. A Vuvrian female. Gambler who owes Jabba 1,000 credits in wagering debts. Speaks many languages.
01153.name: Wioslea
01153.label: Wioslea

01154.gametext: Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
01154.lore: Model T-65 by Incom Corporation. Delivered to Alliance by defecting design team. 12.5 meters long. Wings deploy in an 'X' position for better weapons coverage.
01154.name: X-wing
01154.label: X-wing

01155.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
01155.lore: Rugged Rebel Alliance fighter. BTL-S3 has room for a second pilot to assist weapons operations. 16 meters long. Built by Koensayr.
01155.name: Y-wing
01155.label: Y-wing

01156.dark_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01156.gametext: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.   If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01156.light_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01156.name: Yavin 4
01156.label: Yavin 4

01160.dark_side_text: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
01160.gametext: If you control, with a leader here, all Stormtroopers and TIEs on table are forfeit -1.   If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
01160.light_side_text: If you control, with a leader here, all Stormtroopers and TIEs on table are forfeit -1.
01160.name: Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
01160.label: Yavin 4: Massassi War Room

01163.gametext: Power +1 if at same site as Motti or Yularen. Adds 1 to deploy cost of each opponent's droid (and your 'mouse' droids) when deploying to same location. Immune to attrition during "nighttime conditions."
01163.lore: Aide to Admiral Motti's staff. Foul-tempered and vindictive. Feared by other droids. A spy for the ISB. Secretly investigates Imperial officers whose loyalties are in question.
01163.name: 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)
01163.label: 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)

01165.gametext: Deploys -2 if at least two Imperial starships on table. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Subtracts 1 from forfeit of Rebel pilots at same system.
01165.lore: Senior Navy Commander of Death Star. Believes in technology; ridiculed the Force. Ambitious leader. Promoted due to support of New Order, not military skills. Hates Vader.
01165.name: Admiral Motti
01165.label: Admiral Motti

01167.gametext: Cancel one Effect (or Utinni Effect) by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Sense card just played.
01167.lore: A user of the Force can subjugate the will of others or alter the environment at a distance, as when Vader 'disciplines' those whose lack of faith disturbs him.
01167.name: Alter
01167.label: Alter

01171.lore: TIE/ln assigned to pilot DS-61-2. Has 27 'flames' on cockpit, one for each Rebel kill. Control yoke has a holo of Mithels' young son, Rejili.
01171.name: Black 2
01171.label: Black 2

01172.lore: TIE/ln fighter of pilot DS-61-3. Stylized image of Corellian slice-hound painted on inner hatch.
01172.name: Black 3
01172.label: Black 3

01181.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +1 if at same site as Tarkin. If a battle was just initiated at a system where Bast is present with your non-droid character, may 'evacuate' (relocate) both to a related site.
01181.lore: Aide to Grand Moff Tarkin. Rarely underestimates enemies. Learned cunning and patience hunting big game as a youth.
01181.name: Chief Bast
01181.label: Chief Bast

01185.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Devastator, also adds 1 to hyperspeed. Where present, cancels game text of C-3PO or R2-D2.
01185.lore: Vader's aide on the Devastator. Personally supervised search for Death Star plans on Tatooine by Vader's order. Was graduated with honors from Imperial Navy Academy on Carida.
01185.name: Commander Praji
01185.label: Commander Praji

01187.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 2, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
01187.lore: Pilot DS-61-2. Vader's left wingman. Flies Black 2. Specially trained pilot held in reserve for missions with Vader. Nicknamed "Mauler Mithel."
01187.name: DS-61-2
01187.label: DS-61-2

01188.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
01188.lore: Pilot DS-61-3. Vader's right wingman. Flies Black 3. Reputation for ferocity in combat. Corellian pilot with excellent skills. Nicknamed 'Backstabber.'
01188.name: DS-61-3
01188.label: DS-61-3

01195.gametext: When in battle, adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (or 4 to power and 3 to maneuver if Vader's Custom TIE). Immune to attrition < 5.
01195.lore: Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.
01195.name: Darth Vader
01195.label: Darth Vader

01204.dark_side_text: If you control, with a leader here, all Rebel Troopers and Y-wings on table are forfeit -1.
01204.gametext: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.   If you control, with a leader here, all Rebel Troopers and Y-wings on table are forfeit -1.
01204.light_side_text: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
01204.name: Death Star: War Room
01204.label: Death Star: War Room

01205.gametext: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2.
01205.lore: Supported the devastating subjugation of Ralltiir. While under the command of Darth Vader, chased and captured the traitor Princess Leia Organa aboard the consular ship Tantive IV.
01205.name: Devastator
01205.label: Devastator

01207.gametext: Power +1 for each (Dark Side Force icon) present, +2 under "nighttime conditions." Immune to attrition < 3.
01207.lore: Male Sakiyan, a race often employed as assassins. Bounty hunter. Incredible infrared, peripheral vision. Has excellent aural and olfactory senses. Often tracks by scent.
01207.name: Djas Puhr
01207.label: Djas Puhr

01208.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. The not-so-good doctor may 'operate' on any other character present that was just 'hit' or just Disarmed; 'patient' is lost.
01208.lore: Thug. Smuggler. Twisted 'doctor.' Disfigured by blaster. Has death sentence in over 12 systems. Notorious partner of Ponda Baba. Aliases: Dr. Cornelius and Roofoo.
01208.name: Dr. Evazan
01208.label: Dr. Evazan

01211.gametext: At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
01211.lore: A Givin pilot who can seal his joints to withstand the vacuum of space. Makes slaving and spice runs to Kala'uun. Has made many special modifications to his ship, the Hinthra.
01211.name: Elis Helrot
01211.label: Elis Helrot

01216.characteristics: Black Sun agent, bounty hunter, tax collector
01216.gametext: While no droid present with Trevagg, to initiate battles at same location as Trevagg, player must use X Force, where X = total number of (Dark Side Force icon) icons and (Light Side Force icon) icons present.
01216.lore: Corrupt tax collector. A male Gotal. Bounty hunter. Once sought a bounty on Obi-Wan. Has limited sensing ability to droid emanations. Romanced M'iiyoom Onith.
01216.name: Feltipern Trevagg
01216.label: Feltipern Trevagg

01220.gametext: When at same location as a Rebel of ability > 2, deploy -1 there for any Imperials, and during your move phase, Imperials at an adjacent site may move there for free.
01220.lore: Long-nosed, male Kubaz from Kubindi. Spy. Squealed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or the highest bidder. Not particularly brave.
01220.name: Garindan
01220.label: Garindan

01222.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When with Vader in a battle, once per battle may cancel one opponent's destiny just drawn.
01222.lore: Leader. Governor of Outer Rim Territories. Commanded Death Star. Helped disband Imperial Senate. Defined doctrine of rule by fear. Plotted to use Death Star against Emperor.
01222.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
01222.label: Grand Moff Tarkin

01226.gametext: If a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Rebel is Luke).
01226.lore: "Several fighters have broken off from the main group. Come with me." Darth Vader targets his TIE fighter's fire-linked blaster cannons at the Rebel pilots in the trench.
01226.name: I Have You Now
01226.label: I Have You Now

01229.gametext: Use 1 Force to prevent any character or starship just deployed by the opponent from battling or moving for the remainder of this turn.
01229.lore: As is often the case with a hasty plan, a quick heroic escape from the Death Star was temporarily thwarted by the magnetically sealed door in the trash compactor.
01229.name: Imperial Barrier
01229.label: Imperial Barrier

01241.dark_side_text: Your starships deploy -1 here, -2 if Tarkin is aboard a starship here. If you control, Kessel Run is canceled.
01241.gametext: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.   Your starships deploy -1 here, -2 if Tarkin is aboard a starship here. If you control, Kessel Run is canceled.
01241.light_side_text: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.
01241.name: Kessel
01241.label: Kessel

01248.gametext: Deploy on any system. Target an opponent's starship. Target's power and forfeit = 0. When target reaches Utinni Effect, target draws one destiny. Utinni Effect canceled if destiny > 2. Otherwise, draw again next move phase, etc.
01248.lore: Starships can become damaged in combat and rendered ineffective until they can be repaired and re-outfitted.
01248.name: Lateral Damage
01248.label: Lateral Damage

01252.gametext: If the opponent has two cards or less in hand, opponent must immediately lose 2 Force (4 Force if it is your turn). If the opponent has Fusion Generator Supply Tanks aboard a starship, loss is reduced by 2.
01252.lore: The Empire dominates consumption of resources. Despite being efficient, Rebel logistical and maintenance officers often are compelled to expend emergency reserves.
01252.name: Limited Resources
01252.label: Limited Resources

01255.gametext: If any warrior is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny. OR If Tagge is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny.
01255.lore: Though generally deployed in squads, all Imperial warriors are trained in the close combat techniques and have a reputation for ferocity when cornered.
01255.name: Lone Warrior
01255.label: Lone Warrior

01256.gametext: Use 1 Force to search through the opponent's Used Pile and move any droids you find there to opponent's Lost Pile. OR Use X Force to destroy any one droid on table where X = droid's deploy cost.
01256.lore: Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered droid plating dropped by R2-D2 and C-3PO when exiting escape pod.
01256.name: Look Sir, Droids
01256.label: Look Sir, Droids

01259.gametext: Once during each of your control phases, may reveal opponent's hand by using X Force, where X = number of cards in opponent's hand. All unique (*) male Rebels and unique (*) male aliens there are lost.
01259.lore: Female H'nemthe, a species whose females ritually kill their mates. Stranded on Tatooine due to questionable passage tax. Razor-sharp tongue. M'iiyoom means, 'nightlilly.'
01259.name: M'iiyoom Onith
01259.label: M'iiyoom Onith

01263.gametext: If Tarkin is defending a battle alone, add two battle destiny. OR If any alien is defending a battle alone, add one battle destiny.
01263.lore: A ruthless ruler of Outer Rim Territories, Grand Moff Tarkin used the Death Star to destroy Alderaan, creating the doctrine of rule by fear.
01263.name: Moment Of Triumph
01263.label: Moment Of Triumph

01273.gametext: Deploy on any location to add one (Dark Side Force icon) icon and one (Light Side Force icon) icon.
01273.lore: "A location is affected by the history of the events which occur there. The Force "...binds the galaxy together" and has an ebb and flow."
01273.name: Presence Of The Force
01273.label: Presence Of The Force

01277.gametext: Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of table. During your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.
01277.lore: The Death Star has many terminals coupled to the main reactor for power distribution throughout the immense space station.
01277.name: Reactor Terminal
01277.label: Reactor Terminal

01280.gametext: Use 1 Force to glance at the cards in the opponent's hand for 10 seconds. You may move any one Rebel you find there to the top of opponent's Used Pile.
01280.lore: Imperials use sensitive equipment to search captured ships for shielded compartments. Scanning crew BT-445 planned to search the Millennium Falcon.
01280.name: Scanning Crew
01280.label: Scanning Crew

01282.gametext: Cancel one Interrupt (or one 'react') by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Alter card just played.
01282.lore: "I sense something. A presence I've not felt since..."
01282.name: Sense
01282.label: Sense

01283.gametext: Use 2 Force to target one opponent's character. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's ability, character immediately returns to opponent's hand. (Also, any cards deployed on character return to owners' hands.)
01283.lore: "...bring me the passengers. I want them alive!" Imperial soldiers use blaster stun settings to intimidate or to capture prisoners for questioning and interrogation.
01283.name: Set For Stun
01283.label: Set For Stun

01287.gametext: Deploy on any planet system to cause "nighttime conditions" at related sites. During battles there, both sides add one destiny to power only. Spies deploy free to sites under "nighttime conditions."
01287.lore: When the twin suns of Tatooine set. "Sand People or worse" become a threat, and battles are more dangerous. On Hoth, temperatures drop to deadly extremes.
01287.name: Sunsdown
01287.label: Sunsdown

01294.dark_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01294.gametext: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.   If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01294.light_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.
01294.name: Tatooine
01294.label: Tatooine

01295.dark_side_text: Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each power +1.
01295.gametext: Your aliens here are each forfeit +1.   Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each power +1.
01295.light_side_text: Your aliens here are each forfeit +1.
01295.name: Tatooine: Cantina
01295.label: Tatooine: Cantina

01298.dark_side_text: Your Tusken Raiders here are each forfeit +1. If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01298.gametext: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.   Your Tusken Raiders here are each forfeit +1. If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01298.light_side_text: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.
01298.name: Tatooine: Jundland Wastes
01298.label: Tatooine: Jundland Wastes

01299.dark_side_text: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01299.gametext: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here.
01299.name: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
01299.label: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm

01300.dark_side_text: Your spies, thieves, bounty hunters and smugglers are each power and forfeit +1 here.
01300.gametext: Your spies, thieves, bounty hunters and smugglers are each power and forfeit +1 here.
01300.name: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
01300.label: Tatooine: Mos Eisley

01301.gametext: If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play.
01301.lore: Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought a final lightsaber duel near Hangar Bay 327 on the Death Star. "When I left you I was but the learner; now I am the master."
01301.name: The Circle Is Now Complete
01301.label: The Circle Is Now Complete

01312.gametext: May add 1 pilot. If Vader is pilot, Custom TIE is immune to attrition < 4.
01312.lore: TIE advanced x1 prototype. First of a limited production run leading to the development of the TIE Interceptor. At Vader's insistence a hyperdrive was installed.
01312.name: Vader's Custom TIE
01312.label: Vader's Custom TIE

01314.gametext: Deploy on Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
01314.lore: Custom-built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars, he wielded this weapon while hunting down the last of the Jedi. Cuts through almost anything except another lightsaber blade.
01314.name: Vader's Lightsaber
01314.label: Vader's Lightsaber

01319.dark_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01319.gametext: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.   If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01319.light_side_text: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.
01319.name: Yavin 4
01319.label: Yavin 4

02006.gametext: USED: Select a player to activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Juri Juice or Hypo.
02006.lore: Nutrient-rich beverage common in moisture farm communities. Rumored to have medicinal qualities. Popular in cantinas among those who can't hold their juri juice.
02006.name: Blue Milk
02006.label: Blue Milk

02010.gametext: Power +1 at same location as Han. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Your vehicles, starships, and droids at same site that are 'hit' and about to be lost go to Used Pile instead.
02010.lore: Wookiee smuggler from Kashyyyk. Over 200 years old. Top-notch mechanic and pilot. Jabba has large bounty on this "walking carpet." Friends call him Chewie ... or Fuzzball.
02010.name: Chewbacca
02010.label: Chewbacca

02011.dark_side_text: If you control, each Bith character is destiny -1 and Ghhhk is power +2 in battles at a holosite.
02011.gametext: If you occupy, each Bith character is destiny +2.   If you control, each Bith character is destiny -1 and Ghhhk is power +2 in battles at a holosite.
02011.light_side_text: If you occupy, each Bith character is destiny +2.
02011.name: Clak'dor VII
02011.label: Clak'dor VII

02019.dark_side_text: "Dejarik Rules" in effect here. Site converted by Imperial Holotable.
02019.gametext: "Dejarik Rules" in effect here.   "Dejarik Rules" in effect here. Site converted by Imperial Holotable.
02019.name: Dejarik Hologameboard
02019.label: Dejarik Hologameboard

02021.gametext: If both players have a spy at same site, draw destiny. Add 2 if opponent's spy is Undercover. Opponent's spy is lost if destiny > 2. OR Opponent's Tonnika Sisters present at a site cross to your side.
02021.lore: Typical of impersonators, Shada double-crossed everyone. Her true affiliations still remain a mystery.
02021.name: Double Agent
02021.label: Double Agent

02027.gametext: USED: If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Molator (even at a holosite). OR Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.
02027.lore: Dejarik representation of mythical Molator guardian. The spirit of Grimtaash is said to protect Alderaanian royalty from corruption and betrayal.
02027.name: Grimtaash
02027.label: Grimtaash

02029.gametext: During the damage segment of a battle you lost, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Sunsdown.
02029.lore: Dejarik creature. These ferocious-looking beasts are gentle, loyal, and often domesticated as guard animals or pets on Kinyen, the Gran homeworld.
02029.name: Houjix
02029.label: Houjix

02036.dark_side_text: Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.
02036.gametext: Your Wookiees and smugglers deploy -2 here.   Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.
02036.light_side_text: Your Wookiees and smugglers deploy -2 here.
02036.name: Kashyyyk
02036.label: Kashyyyk

02047.gametext: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all characters transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn.
02047.lore: Smugglers and other rogues frequent spaceports along trade routes. "Your friend is quite a mercenary. I wonder if he really cares about anything, or anybody."
02047.name: Quite A Mercenary
02047.label: Quite A Mercenary

02048.gametext: While aboard any starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver and hyperspeed (3 on Red 5). If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate one Force; 4-6, you may draw top card from Reserve Deck.
02048.lore: Fiesty. Loyal. Heroic. Insecure. Rebel spy. Excels at trouble. Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher. Has picked up a slight flutter. A bit eccentric.
02048.name: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)
02048.label: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)

02049.gametext: While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.
02049.lore: Cheap astromech droid commonly referred to as 'Red.' Purposely blew his motivator to prevent splitting up R2-D2 and C-3PO on Tatooine. Poor navigator but skilled mechanic.
02049.name: R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)
02049.label: R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)

02058.gametext: May add 1 pilot. Opponent may add 2 to destiny drawn for I've Got A Problem Here when targeting Red 6.
02058.lore: Jek Porkins' X-wing at Battle of Yavin. Instrumental in success of strafing attacks against Death Star. Skipped last inspection of computer and flight control systems.
02058.name: Red 6
02058.label: Red 6

02068.gametext: During your control phase, fire one of your weapons. If Han firing, may add 1 to each weapon destiny draw. (A seeker may be targeted by a character weapon using defense value of 4.) Any 'hit' targets are immediately lost.
02068.lore: "I've been looking forward to this for a long time." "Yes, I'll bet you have." Han abruptly ended his conversation with Greedo and flipped Wuher a credit to pay for the cleanup.
02068.name: Sorry About The Mess
02068.label: Sorry About The Mess

02069.gametext: May be deployed even without presence or Force icons. May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
02069.lore: Royal House of Alderaan consular ship. Used by Princess Leia for Imperial Senate business (and secret Rebel espionage). Captured by the Devastator over Tatooine.
02069.name: Tantive IV
02069.label: Tantive IV

02073.gametext: Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily "break cover" (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)
02073.lore: Alliance Intelligence expends considerable resources to infiltrate the Imperial military bureaucracy, but the ISB's security sweeps make these shadowy operations dangerous.
02073.name: Undercover
02073.label: Undercover

02074.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Corellian Slip into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
02074.lore: Highly decorated Corellian. Piloted Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. A wealthy orphan, he bought a freighter with his inheritance. First joined the Alliance as weapons smuggler.
02074.name: Wedge Antilles
02074.label: Wedge Antilles

02075.gametext: Use 3 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played interrupt here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here and use +1 Force for each Interrupt in stack, even if Interrupt is normally free. (Immune to Control.)
02075.lore: Moisture farmers like Own Lars must be on the lookout for repeated (and blatant) ploys by Jawas.
02075.name: What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
02075.label: What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?

02079.gametext: If you control, with a leader here, your starships are each power +1 at Death Star system.   Force drain +1 here.
02079.light_side_text: If you control, with a leader here, your starships are each power +1 at Death Star system.
02079.name: Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins
02079.label: Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins

02086.gametext: May add 1 pilot. May deploy with a pilot as a 'react' to a battle where you have a TIE (for free if TIE is Black 2 or 3).
02086.lore: TIE fighter flown by DS-61-4 at the Battle of Yavin. Scored a hit on Red 5 during the confrontation.
02086.name: Black 4
02086.label: Black 4

02090.gametext: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Just after initiating battle against Falcon, may peek at opponent's hand.
02090.lore: One of the Imperial cruisers that chased the Millennium Falcon from Tatooine. It scanned the Falcon just before Han punched his starship to lightspeed.
02090.name: Conquest
02090.label: Conquest

02091.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 4, also may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Lone Pilot into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
02091.lore: Imperial pilot nicknamed "Dark Curse." Survived assaults against several dissenter worlds including Ralltiir and Mon Calamari. Intends to retire after his next combat mission.
02091.name: DS-61-4
02091.label: DS-61-4

02093.characteristics: Black Sun agent, bounty hunter, gunner
02093.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 1 to weapon destiny draws of anything he is aboard as a passenger.
02093.lore: Cocky gunner and bounty hunter. Maintains a residence on Nar Shaddaa, the spaceport moon of the Hutt homeworld. To his companions' delight, he's nearly as good as he boasts.
02093.name: Danz Borin
02093.label: Danz Borin

02095.dark_side_text: X = parsec of current position. Deploys only at Parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Immune to Revolution. If this is your starting location, Light Side goes first in game.
02095.gametext: X = parsec of current position. Deploys only at Parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Immune to Revolution. If this is your starting location, Light Side goes first in game.
02095.name: Death Star
02095.label: Death Star

02102.gametext: USED: Cancel all Revolutions in play (owner loses 1 Force for each). LOST: If Vader or Vader's Custom TIE was just lost, relocate that card to Used Pile. OR Relocate to Used Pile one Imperial just lost from any Death Star location.
02102.lore: A panic move by Black 2 sent Vader spinning wildly from the Death Star trench - ironically sparing his life. His destiny would be fulfilled another time.
02102.name: Evader
02102.label: Evader

02103.gametext: During the damage segment of a battle you lost, if you have no cards left that can be forfeited, cancel all remaining battle damage. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Nightfall.
02103.lore: Dejarik of creature from Clak'dor VII. Ghhhk rise with the dawn, screeching their mating calls across the jungle. Locals use their skin oils as a healing salve.
02103.name: Ghhhk
02103.label: Ghhhk

02111.gametext: "Dejarik Rules" in effect here. Site converted by Dejarik Hologameboard.   "Dejarik Rules" in effect here.
02111.light_side_text: "Dejarik Rules" in effect here. Site converted by Dejarik Hologameboard.
02111.name: Imperial Holotable
02111.label: Imperial Holotable

02116.dark_side_text: Force drain +1 here. If you control, all Wookiees on table are forfeit -3.
02116.gametext: Your starships with any Wookiee aboard are power and forfeit +2 here.   Force drain +1 here. If you control, all Wookiees on table are forfeit -3.
02116.light_side_text: Your starships with any Wookiee aboard are power and forfeit +2 here.
02116.name: Kashyyyk
02116.label: Kashyyyk

02117.dark_side_text: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Tonnika Sisters anywhere are doubled.
02117.gametext: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.   If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Tonnika Sisters anywhere are doubled.
02117.light_side_text: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.
02117.name: Kiffex
02117.label: Kiffex

02122.gametext: While at Docking Control Room 327, adds 2 to your total power at Docking Bay 327. Once during each of your control phases, if at same site as an Undercover spy, may draw destiny. Spy's "cover is broken" if destiny = spy's ability.
02122.lore: Gantry officer charged with maintaining magnetic field, atmosphere and security in Death Star docking bay. After mission on Ralltiir, paranoid about infiltration by Rebel spies.
02122.name: Lt. Pol Treidum
02122.label: Lt. Pol Treidum

02127.gametext: USED: If opponent has 13 or more cards in hand, place all but 8 (random selection) in Used Pile. LOST: Use 4 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has two or more of in hand are lost.
02127.lore: Dejarik creature. Savage predator from remote deserts of Soccorro. Respected and honored by Soccorran hunters; considered "good luck" by superstitious smugglers.
02127.name: Monnok
02127.label: Monnok

02128.gametext: When opponent is losing Force from Force drains at the same or an adjacent site, lost Force must come from Reserve Deck if possible.
02128.lore: Jabba's Nimbanel accountant. Inside contacts allow him to disrupt the cash flow of the Hutt's enemies. He knows a mistake could make him the next write-off.
02128.name: Mosep
02128.label: Mosep

02130.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When at a Death Star site, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system as a 'react.'
02130.lore: This Imperial Intelligence leader has a proven track record for predicting Rebel fleet movements. His coordination of starship maneuvers has saved many vulnerable bases.
02130.name: Officer Evax
02130.label: Officer Evax

02131.gametext: If Nabrun Leids just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Nabrun is lost and all Rebels transported are captured. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn. OR Cancel a Kessel Run.
02131.lore: Greedo cheskopokuta klees ruya Solo. Hoko yanee boopa gush Cantina. Cheeco wa Solo's anye nyuma Greedo vakee. Jabba kul steeka et en anpaw.
02131.name: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?
02131.label: Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?

02134.gametext: While aboard a capital starship, adds 1 to power and 2 to hyperspeed, and that starship is immune to attrition < 4. While at Death Star: Central Core, hyperspeed of Death Star system = 2.
02134.lore: R3 units have larger memory and more advanced circuitry than their R1 predecessors, allowing for more efficient astrogation plots. R3-T6 served on the Death Star.
02134.name: R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)
02134.label: R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)

02152.gametext: Use 3 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played Interrupt here. To play any new Interrupt of the same name, player must first stack it here and use +1 Force for each Interrupt in stack, even if Interrupt is normally free. (Immune to Control).
02152.lore: Luke's dream of joining the Academy often distracted him from his chores, sometimes resulting in his having to pay the price for his impatience.
02152.name: There'll Be Hell To Pay
02152.label: There'll Be Hell To Pay

02156.gametext: Deploy on opponent's side as an Undercover spy (except that if present during a battle at a site, adds its power to Light Side). If spy's "cover is broken," the above "game text" is canceled and Light Side may use as if stolen.
02156.lore: This protocol droid served in the House of Alderaan's Diplomatic Corps. Imperials altered its programming for espionage, making the droid an unwitting spy for the Empire.
02156.name: U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)
02156.label: U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)

02159.gametext: Deploy on your spy at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Spy is now Undercover. During your deploy phase, may voluntarily "break cover" (lose Effect) if at a site. (Immune to Alter.)
02159.lore: The Empire maintains a network of spies attempting to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance or disinform their operatives.
02159.name: Undercover
02159.label: Undercover

02160.gametext: May add 4 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle and 3 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Adds 1 to your total power in battles at related planet sites.
02160.lore: Commissioned by the Old Republic at end of the Clone Wars, Rendili StarDrive's Victory-class starship is atmosphere-capable but has a low sublight speed.
02160.name: Victory-Class Star Destroyer
02160.label: Victory-Class Star Destroyer

03002.gametext: Deploy on your Skywalker of ability > 3. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
03002.lore: Constructed by Anakin Skywalker. Kept by Obi-Wan Kenobi until given to Luke.
03002.name: Anakin's Lightsaber
03002.label: Anakin's Lightsaber

03029.dark_side_text: Force drain -1 here. If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
03029.gametext: If you control, with X leaders here, your total power is +X in battles at Hoth locations.   Force drain -1 here. If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny.
03029.light_side_text: If you control, with X leaders here, your total power is +X in battles at Hoth locations.
03029.name: Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
03029.label: Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)

03040.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle with a Rebel leader, subtracts 1 from opponent's total battle destiny.
03040.lore: Native of Ralltiir. Spy for Ralltiir's underground network after his homeworld was subjugated.
03040.name: Jeroen Webb
03040.label: Jeroen Webb

03063.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. May move as a 'react' to Hoth sites.
03063.lore: Modified Incom T-47 airspeeder. Enclosed. Adapted to the cold by installation of repulsor coil heaters. Rebels typically nickname converted speeders after the intended environment.
03063.name: Snowspeeder
03063.label: Snowspeeder

03071.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. When at any war room, adds 1 to weapon destiny draws of your Planet Defender Ion Cannon on same planet.
03071.lore: Chief Controller at Echo Command. Responsible for communicating orders to the troops. Personally gives firing orders to Ion Cannon Control.
03071.name: Toryn Farr
03071.label: Toryn Farr

03085.gametext: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Subtracts 1 from deploy cost of each of your capital starships at same system. Lost if Vader on table and opponent 'reacts' to same location as Ozzel.
03085.lore: Leader of the Emperor's Death Squadron assigned to hunt down and crush the Rebellion. As clumsy as he is stupid. Has just failed Darth Vader for the next-to-last time.
03085.name: Admiral Ozzel
03085.label: Admiral Ozzel

03086.gametext: May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Landspeed may not be increased. When using AT-AT Cannon to Target The Main Generator, adds 1 to total.
03086.lore: General Veers' AT-AT. Enclosed. Equipped with highly sophisticated communications gear. Employs an experimental targeting system.
03086.name: Blizzard 1
03086.label: Blizzard 1

03087.gametext: May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Landspeed may not be increased. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
03087.lore: AT-AT commanded by the treacherous General Nevar before he was assassinated. Fortified with an extra layer of armor by the paranoid general. Enclosed.
03087.name: Blizzard 2
03087.label: Blizzard 2

03088.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. May move as a 'react.' Power +1 at any Hoth site. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1.
03088.lore: Enclosed All Terrain Scout Transport (AT-ST). Provides flanking support to the AT-ATs of Blizzard Force. Modified for cold weather combat.
03088.name: Blizzard Scout 1
03088.label: Blizzard Scout 1

03110.gametext: Power +1 when at same site as Admiral Ozzel. Adds 1 to power of each Imperial at same Hoth site. Adds 3 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. On Blizzard 1, also adds 1 to armor and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
03110.lore: General Maximillian Veers is the model of Imperial Army officer. Cunning, loyal and ruthlessly efficient leader. In charge of the ground assault troops in Vader's forces.
03110.name: General Veers
03110.label: General Veers

03114.dark_side_text: Force drain +1 here. Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
03114.gametext: Your troopers are forfeit -1 here   Force drain +1 here. Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
03114.name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter
03114.label: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter

03118.dark_side_text: During your move phase, you may move (for free) between here and Mountains.
03118.gametext: If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.   During your move phase, you may move (for free) between here and Mountains.
03118.light_side_text: If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.
03118.name: Hoth: Ice Plains
03118.label: Hoth: Ice Plains

03120.gametext: If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.   Your Wampas deploy free here.
03120.light_side_text: If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.
03120.name: Hoth: Wampa Cave
03120.label: Hoth: Wampa Cave

03126.gametext: USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.
03126.lore: The Empire's efficient, fear-driven logistical systems can quickly divert weapons and equipment from one conflict to another, focusing on regions of highest strategic priority.
03126.name: Imperial Supply
03126.label: Imperial Supply

03128.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. On Tyrant, also adds 1 to armor. When in battle with an Imperial leader, subtracts 1 from opponent's total battle destiny.
03128.lore: A recent graduate of the Officer's Candidate School on Carida. Serves as first officer of the Tyrant. Ambitious, ruthless and efficient.
03128.name: Lieutenant Cabbel
03128.label: Lieutenant Cabbel

03154.gametext: If you have a piloted AT-AT or AT-ST present at a site, target opponent's character, 'crashed' vehicle or unpiloted vehicle without armor present. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny > ability. Vehicle lost if destiny < 7.
03154.lore: The enormous feet of a walker are designed for mobility on many types of terrain. They also can be used by merciless pilots to crush the Rebellion.
03154.name: Trample
03154.label: Trample

04002.gametext: Insert in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost, but opponent must initiate a battle by the end of opponent's next battle phase or lose 4 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
04002.lore: "The dark side of the Force are they. Easily they flow, quick to join you in a fight."
04002.name: Anger, Fear, Aggression
04002.label: Anger, Fear, Aggression

04015.gametext: Cancel Sense or Alter. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel one Immediate Effect, Mobile Effect or Force drain.
04015.lore: Mystical Jedi power. Covers power of inner mind and body. Allows Jedi to exist in harmony with nature. You must learn this.
04015.name: Control
04015.label: Control

04016.dark_side_text: Neither player may Force drain here.
04016.gametext: During your deploy phase, you may deploy one Dagobah site directly from Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace.   Neither player may Force drain here.
04016.light_side_text: During your deploy phase, you may deploy one Dagobah site directly from Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace.
04016.name: Dagobah
04016.label: Dagobah

04017.dark_side_text: If you occupy, Force generation +1 for you here.
04017.gametext: Your starfighters may deploy here and are immune to Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out here.   If you occupy, Force generation +1 for you here.
04017.light_side_text: Your starfighters may deploy here and are immune to Awwww, Cannot Get Your Ship Out here.
04017.name: Dagobah: Bog Clearing
04017.label: Dagobah: Bog Clearing

04018.dark_side_text: No starships or vehicles here. If you occupy, Force generation +1 for you here.
04018.gametext: No starships or vehicles here. Your creatures are deploy -2 here.   No starships or vehicles here. If you occupy, Force generation +1 for you here.
04018.light_side_text: No starships or vehicles here. Your creatures are deploy -2 here.
04018.name: Dagobah: Jungle
04018.label: Dagobah: Jungle

04019.dark_side_text: At end of your turn, your starships and vehicles here 'sink' to bottom of Lost Pile.
04019.gametext: At end of your turn, your starships and vehicles here 'sink' to Used Pile.   At end of your turn, your starships and vehicles here 'sink' to bottom of Lost Pile.
04019.light_side_text: At end of your turn, your starships and vehicles here 'sink' to Used Pile.
04019.name: Dagobah: Swamp
04019.label: Dagobah: Swamp

04020.dark_side_text: You may use 1 Force to cancel any Force drain here.
04020.gametext: Once per turn, may take one Jedi Test into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.   You may use 1 Force to cancel any Force drain here.
04020.light_side_text: Once per turn, may take one Jedi Test into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
04020.name: Dagobah: Training Area
04020.label: Dagobah: Training Area

04021.dark_side_text: If you occupy, opponent's Yoda's Hut game text is canceled.
04021.gametext: If Yoda here, once per turn, may subtract 2 from attrition against you at another location.   If you occupy, opponent's Yoda's Hut game text is canceled.
04021.light_side_text: If Yoda here, once per turn, may subtract 2 from attrition against you at another location.
04021.name: Dagobah: Yoda's Hut
04021.label: Dagobah: Yoda's Hut

04023.gametext: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. Also, when any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
04023.lore: A Jedi may choose to intervene in the natural course of events, but must accept responsibility for the consequences.
04023.name: Do, Or Do Not
04023.label: Do, Or Do Not

04031.gametext: * Deploy on a Dagobah site. * Target a mentor here. Also, target or deploy (regardless of location deployment restrictions) an apprentice here. * Attempt when targets are present at the beginning of your control phase. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability > 12, test completed: * Place on apprentice. All opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Mentor: Your character of ability > 2. Apprentice: Your non-droid, non-Jedi character of lesser ability than mentor. Each time you complete any Jedi Test, you may exchange one card in hand for one Jedi Test in your Lost Pile.
04031.name: Great Warrior
04031.label: Great Warrior

04039.gametext: Deploy on your starfighter. During any control phase, may target one opponent's capital starship present. Starfighter attaches to target (automatically moves with target and is 'concealed'). May detach at any time (even as target begins to move).
04039.lore: Special modification for starfighters. Size may vary depending on mass of starship. Allows a stable connection to a spacedock, uneven terrain or even another starship.
04039.name: Landing Claw
04039.label: Landing Claw

04046.gametext: Insert in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost and up to the three lowest destiny numbers of each player's characters on table are totaled. Player with lower total loses Force equal to the difference. (Immune to Alter.)
04046.lore: "You said you wanted to be around when I made a mistake, well, this could be it, sweetheart."
04046.name: Never Tell Me The Odds
04046.label: Never Tell Me The Odds

04049.gametext: Use 4 Force to deploy at any site if opponent is generating at least 3 Force more than you. At that site, adjacent sites and same sites as Obi-Wan, players activate Force only if they have presence.
04049.lore: "Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter." The inner consciousness of a Jedi can transcend even death.
04049.name: Obi-Wan's Apparition
04049.label: Obi-Wan's Apparition

04050.gametext: Use 2 Force to deploy on opponent's side of table. At the end of each of opponent's battle phases, if a battle did not take place at every location where both players have presence at the end of that phase, opponent loses 3 Force.
04050.lore: Political pressure forced the Empire to join battle with the Alliance in otherwise tactically poor situations. Failure to engage the enemy was considered tantamount to treason.
04050.name: Order To Engage
04050.label: Order To Engage

04054.dark_side_text: If you control, you may raise your converted Raithal system to the top.
04054.gametext: If you control, all opponent's troopers are forfeit and destiny -1.   If you control, you may raise your converted Raithal system to the top.
04054.light_side_text: If you control, all opponent's troopers are forfeit and destiny -1.
04054.name: Raithal
04054.label: Raithal

04066.gametext: Deploys only on Dagobah or Cloud City. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, during your deploy phase, a lightsaber may deploy on Luke (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.
04066.lore: Luke Skywalker. Son of Anakin. Seeker of Yoda. Levitator of rocks. Ignorer of advice. Incapable of impossible. Reckless is he.
04066.name: Son Of Skywalker
04066.label: Son Of Skywalker

04069.gametext: Use 2 Force to deploy on any Dagobah site. Randomly select two cards from opponent's hand and place them, unseen, face down beneath Stone Pile. Cards return to opponent's hand if Effect leaves table. Canceled if opponent occupies this site.
04069.lore: "Use the Force. Yes... Now, the stone. Feel it."
04069.name: Stone Pile
04069.label: Stone Pile

04076.gametext: Cancel one hologram. OR Use 3 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 to destiny for each asteroid sector on table. If total destiny > 3, Imperial Holotable site is "blown away" (opponent loses 4 Force).
04076.lore: After the mission, the Death Squadron HoloNet communications system reported fifteen system errors: ten computer malfunctions, four power failures and one asteroid.
04076.name: Transmission Terminated
04076.label: Transmission Terminated

04077.gametext: Take one card into hand from Force pile; reshuffle.
04077.lore: Han could always see the light at the end of the tunnel.
04077.name: Tunnel Vision
04077.label: Tunnel Vision

04079.gametext: Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling. Then you choose: USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that interrupt found there is lost.
04079.lore: It's 15 parsecs to Kessel, we've replaced the negative power coupling, it's dark and we're wearing welding goggles. Hit it.
04079.name: Visored Vision
04079.label: Visored Vision

04085.gametext: Deploy on Dagobah I must, but move elsewhere I may, yes. When the mentor, 1 to training destiny I add. Where present am I, battles and attacks happen not unless present a Dark Side character of ability > 3 there is. To attrition, immune am I.
04085.lore: Help you I can, yes. For 800 years have I trained Jedi. Judge me by my size do you? Mm? And well you should not! For my ally is the Force... and a powerful ally it is.
04085.name: Yoda
04085.label: Yoda

04086.gametext: During opponent's turn, take up to four cards from your hand and place them on top of your Force Pile.
04086.lore: "For the Jedi it is time to eat as well."
04086.name: Yoda Stew
04086.label: Yoda Stew

04091.gametext: Insert in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost and up to the three lowest destiny numbers of each player's characters on table are totaled. Player with lower total loses Force equal to the difference. (Immune to Alter.)
04091.lore: What are the odds of having a Corellian, a Wookiee and a protocol droid together with an Alderaanian princess who happens to be the daughter of the Dark Lord of the Sith?
04091.name: 3,720 To 1
04091.label: 3,720 To 1

04094.gametext: USED: Peek at the cards in opponent's Force pile. Reorder however you wish and replace. LOST: Take one Dark Forces into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
04094.lore: "This is a dangerous time for you, when you will be tempted by the dark side of the Force."
04094.name: A Dangerous Time
04094.label: A Dangerous Time

04098.gametext: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Subtract 2 from asteroid destiny draws targeting Avenger.
04098.lore: Key starship used to subjugate Outer Rim worlds. Reassigned to Death Squadron under the command of Captain Needa. Communications ship at the Battle of Endor.
04098.name: Avenger
04098.label: Avenger

04100.gametext: Deploy on opponent's side of table. Luke, Leia, Han, Chewie, Lando, Yoda, and Obi-Wan are each deploy +2. Also, opponent may not play any cards with the words "bad feeling" in the title.
04100.lore: "Ready are you? What know you of ready?"
04100.name: Bad Feeling Have I
04100.label: Bad Feeling Have I

04107.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Apprentices subtract X from training destiny, where X = ability - Jedi Test number (minimum zero). Also, once per turn, you may use 2 Force to move the top card of opponent's Force Pile to the top of opponent's Reserve Deck.
04107.lore: To effectively use the Force, a Jedi is required to learn concentration. A Jedi who gives in to distraction places both himself and his friends in peril.
04107.name: Broken Concentration
04107.label: Broken Concentration

04108.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Avenger, that starship is also immune to attrition < 4. You may re-target applicable Utinni Effects to Needa. If in a battle where you choose to forfeit characters, you must forfeit Needa first.
04108.lore: Able leader and captain of the Avenger. Was given his command by Admiral Ozzel. Treated with suspicion by Darth Vader and the Emperor, who distrust Ozzel's close advisors.
04108.name: Captain Needa
04108.label: Captain Needa

04114.gametext: Cancel Sense or Alter. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel one Immediate Effect, Mobile Effect or Force drain.
04114.lore: Users of the Force can mysteriously manipulate their own physiology and psychology. Control allows rapid healing and provides some immunity to pain, poison and disease.
04114.name: Control
04114.label: Control

04118.dark_side_text: If opponent occupies, your Force icons here are canceled.
04118.gametext: Lose 1 force during each of your control phases if Yoda on table but not on Dagobah.   If opponent occupies, your Force icons here are canceled.
04118.light_side_text: Lose 1 force during each of your control phases if Yoda on table but not on Dagobah.
04118.name: Dagobah: Cave
04118.label: Dagobah: Cave

04119.gametext: Cancel Rogue Asteroid. OR Randomly select one card from opponent's hand and place it, unseen, in Used Pile.
04119.lore: 275 gunners manning 60 turbolaser batteries provide a wide firing arc. Even so, asteroids are a challenge due to the sluggish recharge rates of the high-powered blasters.
04119.name: Defensive Fire
04119.label: Defensive Fire

04123.gametext: May add unlimited pilots, passengers, vehicles and starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3. Immune to attrition < 12.
04123.lore: Flagship of Death Squadron. Over eight kilometers long. Carries 38,000 troops. Can conquer entire star systems by sheer intimidation and terror. Lord Vader's personal command ship.
04123.name: Executor
04123.label: Executor

04126.dark_side_text: If Vader or Emperor on table, your Force generation is +1 here (+2 if both).
04126.gametext: Force drain +1 here. If Vader or Emperor on table, your Force generation is +1 here (+2 if both).
04126.name: Executor: Holotheatre
04126.label: Executor: Holotheatre

04128.dark_side_text: If Vader alone here, once per turn, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny at any system.
04128.gametext: If you occupy, opponent's Meditation Chamber game text is canceled.   If Vader alone here, once per turn, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny at any system.
04128.light_side_text: If you occupy, opponent's Meditation Chamber game text is canceled.
04128.name: Executor: Meditation Chamber
04128.label: Executor: Meditation Chamber

04146.gametext: When at a site, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < X, where X = number of opponent's aliens present.
04146.lore: Commander of Executor bridge pit crews. Native of Brentaal. Participated in the subjugation of Ithor, Kashyyyk, Firro, Sinton and other planets populated by non-humans.
04146.name: Lieutenant Commander Ardan
04146.label: Lieutenant Commander Ardan

04171.gametext: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. Also, when any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
04171.lore: "Always with you what cannot be done."
04171.name: There Is No Try
04171.label: There Is No Try

04172.gametext: USED: Cancel Nabrun Leids. LOST: During your move phase, cancel Landing Claw. OR Cancel Hyper Escape, Closer?! or one 'react.'
04172.lore: "I don't know how we're gonna get out of this one."
04172.name: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
04172.label: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us

04174.gametext: Use 2 Force to take one Interrupt into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
04174.lore: "Sir! Sir! I've isolated the reverse power flux coupling!"
04174.name: Unexpected Interruption
04174.label: Unexpected Interruption

04176.gametext: Lose 2 Force to deploy on Executor: Holotheatre or Death Star: Conference Room. At the end of each player's turn, each player must lose 1 Force. Effect canceled if opponent controls this site. (Immune to Alter.)
04176.lore: Palpatine's hologram. Imposing. Ominous. Intimidating. Instrument for the evil Emperor's sinister reach across the galaxy. Used on a secret frequency of the Imperial HoloNet.
04176.name: Visage Of The Emperor
04176.label: Visage Of The Emperor

04177.gametext: Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling. Then you choose: USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that interrupt found there is lost.
04177.lore: As there are very few local authorities on Dagobah, peeping astromechs can get away with just about anything.
04177.name: Voyeur
04177.label: Voyeur

04179.characteristics: Black Sun agent, bounty hunter, scout
04179.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May move for free as 'react.' Once during each battle, may use 1 Force to cause one alien of ability < 3 at same site to be forfeit = 0 for remainder of turn. Immune to attrition < 3.
04179.lore: Male Gand. Practitioner of ancient religious findsman vocation. Bounty hunter and scout. Gains surprisingly accurate information through mystical visions during meditation.
04179.name: Zuckuss
04179.label: Zuckuss

05009.dark_side_text: If you control, your characters and vehicles deploy -1 to Cloud City locations.
05009.gametext: If you control, opponent's characters and vehicles deploy +1 to Cloud City locations.   If you control, your characters and vehicles deploy -1 to Cloud City locations.
05009.light_side_text: If you control, opponent's characters and vehicles deploy +1 to Cloud City locations.
05009.name: Bespin
05009.label: Bespin

05014.gametext: Deploys only on Falcon, Hoth or Cloud City. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, adds one battle destiny and 2 to maneuver. Once during each battle, may use 2 Force to cancel one opponent's destiny just drawn and cause a re-draw.
05014.lore: Smuggler and scoundrel. His piloting abilities have become legend in the Rebellion. Intends to leave the Alliance to pay off Jabba the Hutt.
05014.name: Captain Han Solo
05014.label: Captain Han Solo

05018.gametext: Deploy on opponent's side of table. At the end of opponent's deploy phase, if they did not deploy a card with ability, opponent loses 2 Force. Effect lost if opponent has more cards with ability on table than you. (Immune to Alter.)
05018.lore: "Attention. This is Lando Calrissian. The Empire has taken control of the city. I advise everyone to leave before more Imperial troops arrive."
05018.name: Civil Disorder
05018.label: Civil Disorder

05019.gametext: Use 2 Force to target a character present with your warrior with a lightsaber. Target cannot move or battle until the end of your next turn. OR Use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one Uncontrollable Fury into hand and reshuffle. OR Cancel Presence Of The Force.
05019.lore: Weooww - bzzzzt - bzt - weoww - bzzzt - weoww - weow - bzt - bzt - bzt - weow - bzzzzzt!
05019.name: Clash Of Sabers
05019.label: Clash Of Sabers

05027.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain -1 here.
05027.gametext: Leia is deploy -2 here   If you control, Force drain -1 here.
05027.name: Cloud City: Guest Quarters
05027.label: Cloud City: Guest Quarters

05032.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.
05032.gametext: If you control, once per turn, may add 1 to a Force drain at a related site. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.   If you control, Force drain +1 here. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.
05032.light_side_text: If you control, once per turn, may add 1 to a Force drain at a related site. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.
05032.name: Clouds
05032.label: Clouds

05034.gametext: One of your Skywalkers present during a battle at a site, for remainder of turn, loses immunity to attrition but adds ability to power (he or she may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny). OR During a duel, add one destiny to your total.
05034.lore: Despite being alone, trapped and desperately outmatched, Luke continued his battle with the Dark Lord of the Sith.
05034.name: Courage Of A Skywalker
05034.label: Courage Of A Skywalker

05044.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. At every site where there is a 'frozen' captive, your Rebels deploy -2 and are power +2 in battle. OR Deploy on top of opponent's Force Pile. Force below this card may not be drawn or used. Effect lost at end of opponent's next turn.
05044.lore: Molten carbonite is released into the chamber and then flash frozen, releasing a blast of air. The subject is instantly covered in the newly solidified material.
05044.name: Frozen Assets
05044.label: Frozen Assets

05047.gametext: Deploy on one of the following systems: Rendezvous Point, Hoth, Yavin 4, Alderaan, or Sullust. Your starships deploy -2 and your pilots deploy -1 here. When battling here, you may add one battle destiny. Effect canceled if opponent controls this system. (Immune to Alter.)
05047.lore: After pursuit, asteroids, a slug, Jedi training, capture, torture, escape, a duel, losing Han and losing a hand, Luke and Leia finally made it to the Alliance's rendezvous point.
05047.name: Haven
05047.label: Haven

05056.gametext: USED: Cancel Sniper or Blasted Droid. LOST: Use 3 Force to cancel any battle just initiated at a site. (Immune to Sense.)
