05056.lore: Luke's decision to ignore Leia's warning about the trap cost him an arm and a. . . well, just a hand, actually.
05056.name: It's A Trap!
05056.label: It's A Trap!

05074.gametext: May add 4 pilots and 4 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Your medical droids and Bacta Tank 'patients' may deploy aboard for free.
05074.lore: Nebulon-B frigate used as a mobile medical facility. Extra cargo space and weapon batteries have been modified to allow for more armor and more recovery areas.
05074.name: Redemption
05074.label: Redemption

05077.gametext: Target a location. Scomp links there cannot be used for remainder of turn. OR If opponent is about to scan or otherwise look through your hand (unless using Monnok), opponent continues but must lose 4 Force plus the card allowing the scan.
05077.lore: "R2-D2, you know better than to trust a strange computer."
05077.name: Shocking Information
05077.label: Shocking Information

05083.gametext: When at a site, adds 1 to your Force drains at related cloud sectors. Also, during your activate phase, if at a Cloud City site and you control Bespin: Cloud City, may cumulatively activate 1 Force for every cloud sector on Bespin.
05083.lore: Long-time Cloud City resident Willow Hood. Employed by a mining company which is sympathetic to the Rebels and sells them Tibanna gas at a discount.
05083.name: Tibanna Gas Miner
05083.label: Tibanna Gas Miner

05091.gametext: Deploy on opponent's side of table. At the end of opponent's deploy phase, if they did not deploy a card with ability, opponent loses 2 Force. Effect lost if opponent has more cards with ability on table than you. (Immune to Alter.)
05091.lore: "Ben. . . Ben, please! Ben. . . Leia! Hear me, Leia!"
05091.name: Ability, Ability, Ability
05091.label: Ability, Ability, Ability

05113.dark_side_text: If you control, add 2 to your Carbon-Freezing destiny.
05113.gametext: If you occupy, subtract 2 from opponent's Carbon-Freezing destiny.   If you control, add 2 to your Carbon-Freezing destiny.
05113.light_side_text: If you occupy, subtract 2 from opponent's Carbon-Freezing destiny.
05113.name: Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber
05113.label: Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber

05141.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Whenever you control any two Rebel Base locations, or any one planet site and two systems, the effects of Revolution and all opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. (Immune to Alter.)
05141.lore: To Imperial command personnel: The Rebellion must be crushed! Minor acts of sedition are to be ignored. The destruction of the Alliance is your primary goal.
05141.name: Imperial Decree
05141.label: Imperial Decree

05154.gametext: Cancel Anger, Fear, Aggression when it is inserted or revealed. OR If your opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain, opponent must choose to use 2 Force, or cancel that battle or Force drain.
05154.name: Projective Telepathy
05154.label: Projective Telepathy

05180.gametext: Use 2 Force to target a character present with your warrior with a lightsaber. Target cannot move or battle until end of your next turn. OR Use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take one I Am Your Father into hand and reshuffle. OR Cancel Uncontrollable Fury.
05180.lore: "It is useless to resist. Don't let yourself be destroyed as Obi-Wan did."
05180.name: You Are Beaten
05180.label: You Are Beaten

06001.gametext: May cancel Torture, Aiiii! Aaa! Agggggggggg! or Sonic Bombardment targeting a character at same site. Once during each of your turns, if with any imprisoned captive, may draw destiny: if destiny > 3, randomly select one captive there to be released.
06001.lore: Starship maintenance droid. Sold into the service of Jabba. Sympathetic to the droids and aliens it is forced to torture. Hates EV-9D9.
06001.name: 8D8
06001.label: 8D8

06005.gametext: During each of your control phases, may take one Hero Of A Thousand Devices or A Gift into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If at a battleground site with C-3PO, may subtract 1 from each opponent's battle destiny at same and related sites.
06005.lore: Counterpart to C-3PO. Spy. Obstinate, headstrong and always full of surprises. R2-D2 was an integral part of Luke Skywalker's rescue plans.
06005.name: Artoo
06005.label: Artoo

06012.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand any non-unique alien. Aliens may deploy from here as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any aliens here may immediately deploy for free).
06012.lore: The alcoves of Jabba's palace are good places to make deals and place bets. Jabba gets a cut of the profits, of course.
06012.name: Bargaining Table
06012.label: Bargaining Table

06042.dark_side_text: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.
06042.gametext: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Vul Tazaene anywhere is doubled.   If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2.
06042.light_side_text: If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Vul Tazaene anywhere is doubled.
06042.name: Kiffex
06042.label: Kiffex

06053.gametext: Once per game, target one non-unique character on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force, where X = the number of copies of that card you have on table. (Immune to Sense.) OR Search your Reserve Deck and take one non-unique alien into hand; reshuffle.
06053.lore: One of the few possessions Jabba brought with him from Nar Shaddaa, the smugglers moon orbiting Nal Hutta. A symbol of renewal in Hutt Society.
06053.name: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes
06053.label: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes

06054.gametext: During your control phase, may cause opponent to reveal entire hand by using X Force, where X = number of cards in opponent's hand. All unique (*) male Imperials or unique (*) male aliens there are placed in opponent's Used Pile.
06054.lore: Female Twi'lek musician. Became a dancer to live a life of luxury. Has worked for Jabba for only two days. Desperate to escape.
06054.name: Oola
06054.label: Oola

06058.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Your Force drains are +1 at holosites and opponent must lose an additional 1 Force to draw a card with Shot In The Dark. (Immune to Alter.) OR Deploy on any planet site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here.
06058.lore: "Greetings, Exalted One. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight and friend to Captain Solo." Hologram.
06058.name: Projection Of A Skywalker
06058.label: Projection Of A Skywalker

06079.gametext: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
06079.lore: With a quick motion of his hand, Luke signaled Artoo and dramatically changed the situation.
06079.name: The Signal
06079.label: The Signal

06080.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here.
06080.gametext: If you occupy, during your control phase, may exchange three cards in hand for any one card in your Lost Pile.   If you control, Force drain +1 here.
06080.light_side_text: If you occupy, during your control phase, may exchange three cards in hand for any one card in your Lost Pile.
06080.name: Tibrin
06080.label: Tibrin

06086.gametext: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Does not attack your characters. When at a Tatooine site, prevents opponent's characters present from using their landspeed.
06086.lore: Large, froglike creature often used by Jawas and other Tatooine denizens as guards. Keeps raiding parties and other unwelcomed guests at bay.
06086.name: Worrt
06086.label: Worrt

06088.gametext: Deploy on your side of the table. While you have fewer than 13 cards in hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except Effects of any kind and Interrupts) are immune to Monnok. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds).
06088.lore: Female dancer from Askajia. Very protective mother. Makes sure that all those she cares about are well protected.
06088.name: Yarna d'al' Gargan
06088.label: Yarna d'al' Gargan

06092.gametext: Once per game, target one non-unique character on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force, where X = the number of copies of that card you have on table. (Immune to Sense.) OR Search your Reserve Deck and take a non-unique alien into hand; reshuffle.
06092.lore: The Abyssins are known for their regenerative abilities. Jabba keeps several statue heads of Abyssin creatures on his repulsorsled.
06092.name: Abyssin Ornament
06092.label: Abyssin Ornament

06103.gametext: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Does not attack your characters. When at a Jabba's palace site, prevents opponents characters from using their landspeed.
06103.lore: Watchbeast. Unwittingly foiled Ree Yees' plot to kill Jabba with a thermal detonator when it ate a crucial component. Louder than it is tough. Keeps watch for unwary intruders.
06103.name: Bubo
06103.label: Bubo

06107.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand, one non-unique alien. Aliens may deploy from here as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any aliens here may immediately deploy for free).
06107.lore: Jabba's palace is considered a safe haven to many on the run. It is also widely known to provide luxurious accommodations to its welcomed guests.
06107.name: Den Of Thieves
06107.label: Den Of Thieves

06113.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a site you control, Imperials are immune to Ke Chu Ke Kukuta? at that site.
06113.lore: Spy for the Empire. Keeping tabs on Jabba's activities for the ISB. Secretly hoping to leave the Empire and pursue lucrative opportunities in the underworld.
06113.name: Fozec
06113.label: Fozec

06114.gametext: Deploys free to same site as Mosep. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at Audience Chamber, adds 1 to your Force drains at Jabba's Palace sites.
06114.lore: Mosep's assistant. Accountant. Tax collector. Enjoys tending to Jabba's skiffs with Barada.
06114.name: Gailid
06114.label: Gailid

06125.gametext: Deploy -2 at Tatooine or Nal Hutta. To use his landspeed requires +2 Force. May escort a captive. While at Audience Chamber, adds 1 to forfeit of all your other aliens and allows you to activate 1 Force for whenever you Force drain with an alien. Immune to attrition < 4.
06125.lore: Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Male heir to Zorba the Hutt. Gangster. Leader of one of the largest criminal organizations in the galaxy. Over six hundred years old.
06125.name: Jabba The Hutt
06125.label: Jabba The Hutt

06127.dark_side_text: Once per game you may deploy one alien here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
06127.gametext: If you control, may use 4 Force to cancel Scum and Villainy. Immune to Revolution.   Once per game you may deploy one alien here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
06127.light_side_text: If you control, may use 4 Force to cancel Scum and Villainy. Immune to Revolution.
06127.name: Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber
06127.label: Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber

06129.dark_side_text: Whenever a bounty hunter delivers a captive here, retrieve 2 Force (once per captive).
06129.gametext: If you control, may use 3 Force to release an imprisoned captive here.   Whenever a bounty hunter delivers a captive here, retrieve 2 Force (once per captive).
06129.light_side_text: If you control, may use 3 Force to release an imprisoned captive here.
06129.name: Jabba's Palace: Dungeon
06129.label: Jabba's Palace: Dungeon

06143.gametext: If opponent just deployed a Rebel to a Jabba's Palace site (and you have no Imperials at any Jabba's Palace site), return Rebel to opponent's hand. Any Force used to deploy that Rebel remains used, and Rebel may not be deployed for the remainder of turn.
06143.lore: Jabba's Gamorrean guards keep a watchful eye for unwelcome guests.
06143.name: None Shall Pass
06143.label: None Shall Pass

06150.characteristics: Black Sun agent, bounty hunter, smuggler
06150.gametext: Thrice per battle at same site, if you just drew a battle destiny of 3, may use 3 Force to add 3 to that destiny.
06150.lore: Gran convicted of murder. Exiled from his homeworld. Smuggler and bounty hunter. Slowly going insane. Fond of making things explode. Plotting to kill Jabba.
06150.name: Ree-Yees
06150.label: Ree-Yees

06153.gametext: Deploy on a desert. Specify starting direction. All characters (except Jawas and Tusken Raiders) present at same non-interior site are missing. During your control phase, moves to next adjacent site (reversing directions as necessary), but lost if at an interior site.
06153.lore: Called "Teeth Of The Wind" by Tusken Raiders. Only those familiar with Tatooine's vast deserts can navigate successfully during its furious onslaught.
06153.name: Sandwhirl
06153.label: Sandwhirl

06154.gametext: Deploy on Audience Chamber. While all your ability on table is provided only by aliens and [Independent] starship pilots, your aliens and starships deploy -1 and you retrieve 2 Force whenever you initiate battle. (Immune to Alter if you control at least three Jabba's Palace sites.)
06154.lore: A relief in Nal Hutta sandstone. Hand-carved by slaves of the great Hutt artist Dreyba. Commissioned by Jabba to illustrate his vast influence. Titled "Ne Ganna Dateel Jabba."
06154.name: Scum And Villainy
06154.label: Scum And Villainy

06157.dark_side_text: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.
06157.gametext: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.   Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.
06157.light_side_text: Your character movement from here (except for scouts) requires +1 landspeed.
06157.name: Tatooine: Desert
06157.label: Tatooine: Desert

06159.dark_side_text: During your deploy phase, may deploy one Jabba's Palace site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
06159.gametext: If you control, opponent's Jabba's Palace game text here is canceled. Immune to Revolution.   During your deploy phase, may deploy one Jabba's Palace site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
06159.light_side_text: If you control, opponent's Jabba's Palace game text here is canceled. Immune to Revolution.
06159.name: Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
06159.label: Tatooine: Jabba's Palace

06163.gametext: USED: Cancel Never Tell Me The Odds if it was just inserted or revealed. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Target a droid at Droid Workshop that you have captured or stolen. Droid is lost. Retrieve Force equal to droid's forfeit (doubled if stolen).
06163.lore: "We have been without an interpreter since our master got angry with our last protocol droid and disintegrated him."
06163.name: Torture
06163.label: Torture

06166.gametext: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. STARTING: Deploy from your Reserve Deck one Effect which has no deploy cost; reshuffle. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
06166.name: Twi'lek Advisor
06166.label: Twi'lek Advisor

06175.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. While you have fewer than 13 cards in your hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except Effects of any kind and Interrupts) are immune to Grimtaash. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds).
06175.lore: Most of Jabba's guards had been sold to the Hutt and were too scared (or too dumb) to leave. Jabba assigned his best guards to watch over his most prized possessions.
06175.name: Well Guarded
06175.label: Well Guarded

07001.gametext: Your vehicles and devices deploy -1 here. Once during each of your control phases, may place your weapon, device or non-creature vehicle present on top of Reserve Deck. When on Crash Site Memorial, that Effect is immune to Alter.
07001.lore: Extremely common menial-labor droid. Used for a variety of tasks. Mostly used for transporting heavy objects from one place to another.
07001.name: ASP-707 (Ayesspee)
07001.label: ASP-707 (Ayesspee)

07003.gametext: While at an Alderaan site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your general is on Alderaan) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Alderaan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
07003.lore: Many of the Alliance's generals and commanders are from Alderaan. Not all of Alderaan's population are active members of the Rebellion, but most support the cause.
07003.name: Alderaan Operative
07003.label: Alderaan Operative

07004.gametext: Once per game, target one non-unique starfighter on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force, where X = number of copies of that card you have on table. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one non-unique starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
07004.lore: "Red 10 standing by." "Red 7 standing by." "Red 3 standing by." "Red 6 standing by." "Red 9 standing by." "Red 2 standing by." "Red 11 standing by." "Red 5 standing by."
07004.name: All Wings Report In
07004.label: All Wings Report In

07007.gametext: Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May fire two or more weapons during battle. Each of its weapon destiny draws is +1. During your turn, may use 1 Force to 'defuse' (lose) an Orbital Mine present.
07007.lore: First models designed in Roche asteroid field by Admiral Ackbar's team of Verpine engineers. Early design equipped to detect and neutralize Imperial orbital mines.
07007.name: B-wing Attack Fighter
07007.label: B-wing Attack Fighter

07016.gametext: While at a Clak'dor VII site: adds 1 to your Force drains there, is forfeit +1 (and power +1 if your musician is on Clak'dor VII) and, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one site to Clak'dor VII from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
07016.lore: Hired by the Alliance after the ecological disaster on Clak'dor VII. Brought food supplies and medicine to the Bith, securing their loyalty to the Rebellion.
07016.name: Clak'dor VII Operative
07016.label: Clak'dor VII Operative

07034.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel or Naboo. Each of your battle destiny draws is -1 here. Sandwhirl here moves only if on Tatooine.
07034.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel or Naboo. Your Jawas may deploy here. Sandwhirl here moves only if on Tatooine.   May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel or Naboo. Each of your battle destiny draws is -1 here. Sandwhirl here moves only if on Tatooine.
07034.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth, Kessel or Naboo. Your Jawas may deploy here. Sandwhirl here moves only if on Tatooine.
07034.name: Desert
07034.label: Desert

07041.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Whenever a battle is initiated, player initiating battle retrieves 1 Force and defender loses 1 Force. Also, during a battle you initiate, each time opponent plays an interrupt, opponent must first use 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)
07041.lore: "I'm going to cut across the axis and try and draw their fire."
07041.name: Draw Their Fire
07041.label: Draw Their Fire

07046.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth or Kessel.
07046.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth or Kessel. During your deploy phase, Hydroponics Station or Vaporator may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.   May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth or Kessel.
07046.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Hoth or Kessel. During your deploy phase, Hydroponics Station or Vaporator may deploy here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
07046.name: Farm
07046.label: Farm

07049.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine.
07049.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your characters present here are immune to attrition.   May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine.
07049.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your characters present here are immune to attrition.
07049.name: Forest
07049.label: Forest

07056.gametext: Power +1 at a swamp. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a battleground site, whenever you must lose Force from a Force drain at an adjacent site, may reduce the loss by X by using X Force.
07056.lore: Ishi Tib accountant. Experienced administrator. Freelance consultant. Worked for many planetary governors. Knows how to get the most out of any taxation scheme.
07056.name: Harc Seff
07056.label: Harc Seff

07060.gametext:
[Front Side]: Deploy Rendezvous Point. Place a planet system (with a parsec number from 1 to 8) from outside your Reserve Deck face down on your side of table (not in play); that card indicates the planet where your "Hidden Base" is located.
While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at systems and sectors.
Flip this card any time after you have deployed five battleground systems and your "Hidden Base" system.\
[Back Side]: While this side up, to draw a card from Force Pile, opponent must first use 1 Force. For each battleground system you control, you may cancel one opponent's Force drain (limit twice per turn). You may not deploy any systems. At each system opponent occupies during any deploy phase, opponent may 'probe' there by placing one card from hand face down beneath that system.
Place out of play if "Hidden Base" system is 'probed;' Dark Side places 'probe' cards in Used Pile (and may retrieve 1 Force for each Probe Droid used to 'probe').
07060.name: Hidden Base/Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers
07060.label: Hidden Base/Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

07070.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Force drain -1 here. Your attrition against opponent is -2 here.
07070.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your aliens and creature vehicles are each power +1 here.   May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Force drain -1 here. Your attrition against opponent is -2 here.
07070.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Your aliens and creature vehicles are each power +1 here.
07070.name: Jungle
07070.label: Jungle

07078.gametext: If opponent just lost a starship in a battle you won, deploy on your participating starfighter. Once during each of opponent's move phases, opponent loses 1 Force (2 if starfighter is Falcon or Red 5). Also, that starfighter is power +2. (Immune to Control.)
07078.lore: The Millennium Falcon's well-known reputation is favorable not only for its captain and first mate, but for the Alliance as well.
07078.name: Legendary Starfighter
07078.label: Legendary Starfighter

07084.gametext:
[Front Side]: Deploy any planet system and one <> site to that system. This system is the Subjugated planet.
While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, you may deploy one <> site to the Subjugated planet from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
Flip this card if your matching operatives control at least three battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet.\
[Back Side]: While this side up, opponent's Force drains are -1. You may retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to the Subjugated planet. Your matching operatives on that planet are each forfeit +2 and, when at same site as an Imperial or AT-AT, are each power +2. When you have at least one matching operative in a battle on the Subjugated planet, you may add one battle destiny.
Flip this card if you do not occupy at least two battleground sites related to the Subjugated planet.
07084.name: Local Uprising/Liberation
07084.label: Local Uprising/Liberation

07086.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Once during each of your control phases, may use 1 Force: your combat vehicles and shuttle vehicles are power and forfeit +2, maneuver +1 and landspeed = 0 until start of your next turn. (Immune to Alter if Luke or Zev on table.)
07086.lore: Enhanced steering mechanisms on Rebel T-47s provide increased maneuverability in planetary atmospheres.
07086.name: Maneuvering Flaps
07086.label: Maneuvering Flaps

07087.gametext: Deploy on an exterior site. Target an opponent's combat vehicle at a related site. Target's power and forfeit = 0. When target reaches Utinni Effect, target draws one destiny. Utinni Effect canceled if destiny > 2. Otherwise, draw again next move phase, etc.
07087.lore: The massive war machines of the Empire require tremendous effort to maintain combat readiness.
07087.name: Mechanical Failure
07087.label: Mechanical Failure

07097.gametext: USED: If a battle was just initiated, each of your X-wings and Y-wings present is power +1 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn. LOST: Lose 1 Force to take up to three non-unique X-wings and/or non-unique Y-wings into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
07097.lore: "Hold up here and wait for my signal to start your run."
07097.name: Organized Attack
07097.label: Organized Attack

07104.gametext: While aboard your capital starship, adds 1 to power and 2 to hyperspeed, and that starship is immune to attrition < 4. While at Central Core, Death Star requires +2 Force to move.
07104.lore: Expanded memory capacity. Escaped from pirates based in Mos Eisley. Programmed with the ability to both enhance and sabotage hyperdrive systems.
07104.name: R3-T2 (Arthree-Teetoo)
07104.label: R3-T2 (Arthree-Teetoo)

07109.gametext: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand any non-unique starfighter. Starfighters may deploy from here as if from hand (if Effect canceled by opponent, any starfighters here may immediately deploy for free).
07109.lore: To avoid unnecessary Imperial entanglements, the Rebel fleet is continuously on the move.
07109.name: Rebel Fleet
07109.label: Rebel Fleet

07114.gametext: Your starships deploy -2 here and are hyperspeed +2 when moving to or from here. Neither player may Force drain here.
07114.light_side_text: Your starships deploy -2 here and are hyperspeed +2 when moving to or from here. Neither player may Force drain here.
07114.name: Rendezvous Point
07114.label: Rendezvous Point

07121.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May move as a 'react' to Tatooine or desert sites.
07121.lore: Incom T-47 airspeeder adapted for use in hot, dry conditions. Maximum speed 600 kilometers per hour. Drive section left exposed for easier maintenance. Enclosed.
07121.name: Sandspeeder
07121.label: Sandspeeder

07123.gametext: Habitat: planet sites. Landspeed = 2. Ferocity +2 when present at Mos Eisley or any <> spaceport site.
07123.lore: Considered to be a nuisance. Feeds on garbage. Its only defense is its speed. Nasty bite attack when surprised or cornered. Grow as big as 1.2 meters long.
07123.name: Scurrier
07123.label: Scurrier

07129.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. If your thief or scout present, Force drain +1 here.
07129.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. If you have a non-unique Rebel leader at same or related site, Force drain +1 here.   May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. If your thief or scout present, Force drain +1 here.
07129.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. If you have a non-unique Rebel leader at same or related site, Force drain +1 here.
07129.name: Spaceport City
07129.label: Spaceport City

07130.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.
07130.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here.   May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.
07130.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here.
07130.name: Spaceport Docking Bay
07130.label: Spaceport Docking Bay

07131.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. Imperials are power -1 here.
07131.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. During your move phase, may move free between here and any related <> spaceport site.   May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. Imperials are power -1 here.
07131.light_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk or Yavin 4. During your move phase, may move free between here and any related <> spaceport site.
07131.name: Spaceport Street
07131.label: Spaceport Street

07132.gametext: May deploy -3 as a 'react.' May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking ability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
07132.lore: Has conducted several successful ambushes on Imperial convoys. Veteran crew. Has a reputation for arriving when least expected.
07132.name: Spiral
07132.label: Spiral

07137.dark_side_text: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. To initiate battle here, you must use +3 Force. You may not 'react' to or from here.
07137.gametext: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. 07164.label: A Bright Center To The Universe

07201.label: Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith

07238.label: Jabba

08172.name: Tempest Scout 1
08172.label: Tempest Scout 1

08173.gametext: Deploy -1 to Endor. May add 2 pilots or passengers. May move as a 'react'. Immune to attrition < 3 when Marquand piloting. Your scouts may move here as a 'react.'
08173.lore: AT-ST assigned to coordinate battle activities with the Endor biker scout detachment. Enclosed. First saw battle in Kashyyyk forests.
08173.name: Tempest Scout 2
08173.label: Tempest Scout 2

08174.gametext: May deploy or move as a 'react' to a forest or Endor site. May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
08174.lore: Enclosed. Assigned to the task of searching for potential Rebel traps. Modified to help cover more territory to accomplish this task.
08174.name: Tempest Scout 3
08174.label: Tempest Scout 3

08176.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Adds 1 to your total power in battle at same site for each of your other piloted combat vehicles present.
08176.lore: Uses experimental command and control software to coordinate combat data. Enclosed.
08176.name: Tempest Scout 5
08176.label: Tempest Scout 5

09036.gametext: USED: Add 1 to your battle destiny just drawn. STARTING: Deploy up to three Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has "deploy on table" (or "deploy on your side of table") in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
09036.lore: At the Battle of Endor, Rebel starships fought to defend key capital starships, such as the Redemption.
09036.name: Heading For The Medical Frigate
09036.label: Heading For The Medical Frigate

09041.gametext: Deploy on table. Unless opponent occupies three battlegrounds, each time you must lose Force (except from your card, battle damage or a Force drain at a battleground), reduce the loss by 2. (Immune to Alter while you occupy any battleground).
09041.lore: The final act of Luke's ascension to Jedi Knighthood was sending off his father, draped in the garb of Vader.
09041.name: Honor Of The Jedi
09041.label: Honor Of The Jedi

09078.gametext: To move your starship between here and Death Star II, system it orbits or Mon Calmari requires -1 force.   Your starships deploy +1 here.
09078.light_side_text: To move your starship between here and Death Star II, system it orbits or Mon Calmari requires -1 force.
09078.name: Sullust
09078.label: Sullust

09091.gametext: Deploy on table. Opponent's Dark Jedi are defense value -1. Scanning Crew and 3,720 To 1 are canceled. You may place Effect in Lost Pile to take one [Endor] or [Death Star II] Effect that deploys for free into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
09091.lore: Luke knew that while the dark side was quicker and more seductive, eventually evil would turn on itself.
09091.name: Your Insight Serves You Well
09091.label: Your Insight Serves You Well

09103.gametext: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 while an Imperial leader aboard, < 6 while Thrawn aboard).
09103.lore: Early model Imperial-class Star Destroyer. Acting command ship in the absence of Executor.
09103.name: Chimaera
09103.label: Chimaera

09145.gametext: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at each docking bay you occupy (or +2 if you control). Once per game, you may take one Carida, Wakeelmui, Gall, Kuat, or Rendili system or Executor into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
09145.lore: The Imperial noose relies on swift troop dispatch from docking bays.
09145.name: Mobilization Points
09145.label: Mobilization Points

09154.gametext: USED: Add 1 to your battle destiny just drawn. STARTING: Deploy up to three Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has "deploy on table" (or "deploy on your side of table") in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.
09154.lore: Since the debacle at Yavin, the Emperor places a premium on the security of his costly war machine.
09154.name: Prepared Defenses
09154.label: Prepared Defenses

09180.gametext: Deploy on table. Opponent's Jedi are defense value -1. Never Tell Me The Odds is canceled. You may place Effect in Lost Pile to take one [Endor] or [Death Star II] Effect that deploys for free into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
09180.lore: "Give yourself to the dark side. It is the only way you can save your friends."
09180.name: You Cannot Hide Forever
09180.label: You Cannot Hide Forever

14007.dark_side_text: Tarkin deploys free here. If you control, all Imperials with ability > 2 on table are forfeit +2.
14007.gametext: If you control, Force drain +1 here   Tarkin deploys free here. If you control, all Imperials with ability > 2 on table are forfeit +2.
14007.light_side_text: If you control, Force drain +1 here
14007.name: Eriadu
14007.label: Eriadu

14008.gametext: If opponent's starship has just begun to move through hyperspace, draw destiny. If destiny > pilot's ability, starship must return to original location and may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost.
14008.lore: "Traveling through hyperspace ain't like dustin' crops, boy!" Gravititational phenomena cast shadows in hyperspace, posing a serious threat to lightspeed navigation.
14008.name: Gravity Shadow
14008.label: Gravity Shadow

15003.set_name: The Empire Strikes Back Two-Player Game
15003.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.
15003.lore: Technicians at the Rebel Base on Hoth modified T-47 airspeeders to fly in the frigid atmosphere of the ice planet. Enclosed.
15003.name: Rebel Snowspeeder
15003.label: Rebel Snowspeeder

16001.gametext: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard is (*]Dutch, who provides ability of 2, adds 2 to power and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
16001.lore: At the Battle of Yavin, Dutch led his squadron of outdated but reliable Y-wings in the first wave of the assault against the Death Star.
16001.name: Gold Leader In Gold 1
16001.label: Gold Leader In Gold 1

16002.gametext: Permanent pilot aboard is (*]Red Leader, who provides ability of 2, adds 2 to power and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
16002.lore: Called 'Boss' or 'Chief' by his squadron, Garven Dreis was the first pilot to fire proton torpedoes at the Death Star's exhaust port during the Battle of Yavin.
16002.name: Red Leader In Red 1
16002.label: Red Leader In Red 1

17002.dark_side_text: If you control, Force drain -1 here.
17002.gametext: If you control, all non-unique Rebels are power and forfeit +1 and Rebel guards may move.   If you control, Force drain -1 here.
17002.light_side_text: If you control, all non-unique Rebels are power and forfeit +1 and Rebel guards may move.
17002.name: Corulag
17002.label: Corulag

17004.gametext: Deploy -2 at Yavin 4 or to same location as Dutch. May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Adds 1 to its ion cannon weapon destiny draws.
17004.lore: Gold Squadron had the best Y-wing pilots in the Alliance. Lead by Jon 'Dutch' Vander. First wave of starfighters to assault the Death Star. Many were lost in the Battle of Yavin.
17004.name: Gold Squadron Y-wing
17004.label: Gold Squadron Y-wing

17005.gametext: USED: Cancel a Force drain at a site related to a system you control. LOST: Cancel Counter Assault, It's Worse, Elis Helrot, Tallon Roll, Limited Resources or Scanning Crew. OR Use 3 Force to search your Lost Pile and take one non-unique starfighter into hand.
17005.lore: Red Leader fired the first shot in the Death Star trench, causing massive internal damage. The spectacular near-miss inspired Red Squadron to double their efforts.
17005.name: It's A Hit!
17005.label: It's A Hit!

17007.gametext: Deploy -2 at Yavin 4 or to same location as Red Leader. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Proton Torpedoes deploy and fire free aboard.
17007.lore: Most Red Squadron pilots trained under Garven Dreis. Flew top cover during the Battle of Yavin. Became famous for Red 5's historic attack run.
17007.name: Red Squadron X-wing
17007.label: Red Squadron X-wing

17011.gametext: When deployed, you may take one non-unique alien into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your aliens deploy -1 to same or adjacent Tatooine site.
17011.lore: Male Morseerian leader. Methane breather. Has ties to Tatooine's Imperial government. Uses alien agents to maintain surveillance on Jabba and the Rebellion.
17011.name: Chall Bekan
17011.label: Chall Bekan

17013.gametext: May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2. Turbolaser Battery may deploy aboard. Your TIEs present are each power +1.
17013.lore: Introduced during the Clone Wars. 600 meters long. Some have cargo space converted to TIE hangar bays. Still used to maintain an Imperial presence in the Outer Rim.
17013.name: Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser
17013.label: Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser

18001.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Luke or Chewie. Permanent weapon is (*]Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
18001.lore: Scoundrel, smuggler, gambler and risk taker. "Everything's going to be fine. Trust me."
18001.name: Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol
18001.label: Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol

18002.gametext: Adds 1 to power of anything she pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Han. Permanent weapon is (*]Leia's Blaster Rifle (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
18002.lore: Spirited leader. "I am not a committee!"
18002.name: Leia With Blaster Rifle
18002.label: Leia With Blaster Rifle

18003.gametext: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is (*]Luke's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
18003.name: Luke With Lightsaber
18003.label: Luke With Lightsaber

18005.characteristics: Black Sun agent, bounty hunter, blaster rifle, rifle
18005.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Han or Jabba. Permanent weapon is (*]Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).
18005.name: Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle
18005.label: Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle

18006.gametext: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is (*]Vader's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
18006.lore: "If you only knew the power of the dark side."
18006.name: Darth Vader With Lightsaber
18006.label: Darth Vader With Lightsaber

19002.gametext: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is (*]Lando, who provides ability of 3 and adds 3 to power. May not be piloted by Han unless he won a hand of sabbac this game. Immune to attrition < 5.
19002.lore: Heavily modified Corellian YT-1300 freighter. "She's the fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy."
19002.name: Lando In Millennium Falcon
19002.label: Lando In Millennium Falcon

19008.gametext: May add 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is (*]Boba Fett, who provides ability of 3, adds 3 to power, adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < 5.
19008.lore: Dangerous and deadly starfighter piloted by its notorious owner. Uses combat-grade shields and sensors. Hidden weapons provide lethal surprises for Fett's victims.
19008.name: Boba Fett In Slave I
19008.label: Boba Fett In Slave I
